h:
该工作流程将 6 个采样器链接在一起，每个采样器使用不同的步骤，并将图像拼接在一起形成单个输出。每个图像都标有所使用的步骤数，并且图像标有所使用的模型。

我用它来评估增加步数的成本效益。它也有利于分析新模型，看看它们在低步和高步时的表现如何。

o.en:
This workflow chains together 6 samplers using different steps for each one and stitches the images together into a single output. Each image is labeled with the number of steps used and the image is labeled with the model that was used.

I used this to evaluate the cost benefit of going to higher step counts. Its also good for analysis on new models to see how they behave at low steps and high steps.
